title: The Law Studio's engine, and the official texts of its schemes
about: The law engine, a program around the API's composition of the law domain compiled with g++ 11 or later (natively or in WSL) into data/cache/engines/law-studio/law/; then the official texts of the instruments its schemes cite, fetched from their publishers into the data library's cache and read into provisions, so that every clause a rule cites is read in its own words (they are kept in the cache only, each with its source and the date it was fetched).
